evidence.title: Post-Train NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge for On-Device Robot Control
evidence.excerpt: Robotics Post-Train NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge for On-Device Robot Control Aug 19, 2026 By Saeed Babamohamadi Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Jetson Thor can run the 4B Cosmos 3 Edge omni-model natively for on-device robot manipulation policies. Post-training Cosmos 3 Edge on the Cosmos3-DROID dataset produces a policy that generates action chunks in about 1.53 seconds on Jetson AGX Thor T5000, enabling continuous real-time control. In closed-loop RoboLab evaluation, the post-trained Edge policy reaches 22.9% success across 120 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. The Cosmos framework provides reproducible post-training and deployment scripts through the open cosmos-framework repository. Next Steps Download the Cosmos Edge policy weights and data to begin post-training. Explore Cosmos Edge on Jetson for deployment guidance and examples. Get the Cosmos framework code on GitHub to access post-training and deployment scripts. Powered by NVIDIA Nemotron. AI-generated content may summarize information incompletely.
